mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 10.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing the risk of a recession and prompting equity investors to demand higher risk premiums, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 10.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect fails to produce a Rank IC above 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.5 for two consecutive months indicates strong supply-side momentum, which correlates with rising corporate profitability and positive earnings revisions, driving S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in less than 55% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 100.5, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 258.5 over the past month signals accelerating inflation, prompting expectations of tighter monetary policy and higher real interest rates, which reduce equity valuations and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 258.5, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in both GDP (GDPC1) and residential construction (HOUST) over the past four months indicates a broad-based contraction in aggregate demand, increasing the likelihood of a recession and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 55% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or the interaction effect fails to yield a Rank IC above 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 139,000 over the past month signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending power and corporate hiring expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 55% of instances when PAYEMS falls below 139,000, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.5 combined with a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 10.0% indicates a strong, labor-constrained expansion, boosting corporate margins and earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in fewer than 55% of instances when both INDPRO > 100.5 and UNRATE < 10.0%, or the interaction effect fails to produce a Rank IC above 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.
